description: This line plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across different datasets for three attack strategies—labeled "start", "random", and "end"—under a 10% poison rate condition on the AGNews dataset with clean labels. The x-axis represents the datasets, labeled as "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", and "Estadio", with no numerical scale or units provided. The y-axis represents the ASR, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The "start" attack is depicted by a green line with triangle markers, the "random" attack by an orange line with 'x' markers, and the "end" attack by a purple line with circular markers. The "start" line begins at an ASR of approximately 0.77, dips to a low of 0.49 on the "bb" dataset, then rises to a peak of 0.90 on the "WNBA" dataset before declining to 0.81 on "ESPN" and rising again to 0.92 on "FIFA" before falling to 0.82 on "Estadio". The "random" line starts at 0.65, drops to 0.50 on "bb", rises to 0.90 on "WNBA", then declines to 0.72 on "ESPN", rises to 0.89 on "NHL", peaks at 0.91 on "FIFA", and ends at 0.87 on "Estadio". The "end" line begins at 0.75, drops to 0.57 on "bb", rises to 0.90 on "WNBA", then declines to 0.75 on "ESPN", rises to 0.89 on "NHL", peaks at 0.93 on "FIFA", and ends at 0.82 on "Estadio".
